visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair in a cream shirt sits at a round table, wide-eyed and covering his mouth in shock. In front of him are elaborate yellow desserts with dry ice smoke. In the background, a dense crowd of people stands with their backs to the camera, looking toward a bright window. (2) The camera pans right, revealing more people in white and black clothing, all holding up smartphones to film something outside the frame. The setting is a brightly lit, pink-accented indoor venue with overhead lighting. (3) The camera pushes forward through the crowd towards the window. Multiple people's heads and hands holding phones are visible in the foreground, blocking much of the view. (4) The shot settles on a window display featuring Powerpuff Girls themed desserts, including a tall red and yellow parfait and a smaller yellow character dessert. Plumes of white dry ice smoke billow around the food. The background outside the window shows parked scooters and a street.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous twist to play with the viewer's expectations. It starts by showing a man shocked by a massive crowd of 'stalkers' with phones out, implying they are chasing a celebrity. The narrative shift reveals that the entire crowd is actually just filming a highly decorative and trendy dessert, mocking the excessive hype and social media obsession surrounding food trends.
